Program Description:

The Art Department offers two programs of study in the Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) Degree. The Art History and Visual Studies concentration develops students’ skills in research, visual analysis, and argumentation, leading to a range of careers in the arts or to graduate study. The concentration in Art & Design provide broad survey art and design practices in preparation for continued professional development or creative and design careers. 


The B.A. Degree Concentrations:

1) Art History & Visual Studies

2) Art & Design


The program core plus concentrations require 54-60 units of study in the Department to complete the major. Students of Art & Design who wish to meet full professional expectations or attend Graduate School are encouraged to choose one of the concentrations in the Bachelor of Fine Arts (B.F.A). program.
